items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 3:00 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Phase 2 update - Kitchener Utilities Transition, INS-2024-224
notes:
Council considered Infrastructure Services Department report INS-2024-224, dated May 27, 2024, regarding an update on the progress of Phase 2 of the Kitchener Utilities Clean Energy Transition Strategy.

K. Daley, Senior Strategist, Carbon and Energy Planning, presented an overview of the report. A. Cipriani, Sustainability Officer, A. Hustwitt, Manager Business Development and Customer Experience, K. Abu-Eseifan, Manager Gas Supply and Engineering and G. St. Louis, Director, Utilities Gas and Water were also in attendance to respond to questions from Council.

K. Daley requested Council feedback on the following questions: 

  1. What are your reflections on the business activity themes and what theme are you most curious about?
  2. Referring to Appendix A, as outlined in Infrastructure Services Department report INS-2024-224, are there any considerations for investigation that you feel:
    a. Should be prioritized or de-prioritized
    b. Should be added

Councillor M. Johnston entered the meeting at this time. 

In response to questions from Council, K. Daley noted engagement workshops were held with external stakeholders and Kitchener Utilities staff members to help identify and explore potential business activities that could be investigated, including potential modifications to existing programs, equity considerations, and various business approaches. 

In response to further questions, G. St. Louis noted while staff are not currently exploring the potential of implementing gas bill surcharges, staff will continue to explore methods to offer additional incentives to customers transitioning away from the use of natural gas. 

Councillor P. Singh entered the meeting at this time.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 3:39 p.m.
